name: ofp_audio
title: OP FREAK audio callback layer
status_note: built only; never run on a device
summary: Wraps TE's audio render callback (the original is always called) and lets other OP FREAK platform features hook the output block (master gain) and read per-block measurements (probe) through optional functions.

entry_hooks.what: audio::set_callback: keep our wrapper in front of the render callback
